# Integrations (web)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Client workflows and their builder, connectors, client steps, pipeline tokens and write-back.

## Files

- `ClientSteps.vue`: v1.7.3: the client's own steps for this use case, from the published client workflow it follows.
- `ConnectorForm.vue`: The connector form (v1.7.2), used in Settings > Connected tools and, in place, from a workflow step.
- `ConnectorsTab.vue`: Connectors: read-only pulls from the client's business tools and report links.
- `PipelinesCard.vue`: v1.7.3: pipelines push evidence (Settings > Connected tools).
- `WorkflowBuilderPage.vue`: The workflow builder (v1.7).
- `WorkflowInspector.vue`: The workflow builder's inspector, on the right: the selected step's settings (type, label, tool, connector, proof), the rules the drawing breaks, versions and publishing.
- `WorkflowsPage.vue`: Client workflows (v1.7): the list.
- `WriteBackCard.vue`: v1.7.3: write-back (Settings > Connected tools).
- `use-workflow-builder.ts`: Everything the workflow builder knows and does (v1.7.8: moved out of WorkflowBuilderPage.vue so the inspector is its own component).

## Pages

| Address | Page |
|---|---|
| `/workflows` | `WorkflowsPage.vue` |
| `/workflows/:id` | `WorkflowBuilderPage.vue` |

The server side is in [`apps/server/src/integrations`](../../../../server/src/integrations/README.md).
